# 74175 - Quadruple D-type flip-flop with clear

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74175.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74175.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 35 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74175 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74175.png) | ![74175 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74175.png) | ![74175 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74175.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 1Q = FF1 | Flip-flop 1 output. |
| 3 | /1Q = NOT FF1 | Complement of flip-flop 1. |
| 7 | 2Q = FF2 | Flip-flop 2 output. |
| 6 | /2Q = NOT FF2 | Complement of flip-flop 2. |
| 10 | 3Q = FF3 | Flip-flop 3 output. |
| 11 | /3Q = NOT FF3 | Complement of flip-flop 3. |
| 15 | 4Q = FF4 | Flip-flop 4 output. |
| 14 | /4Q = NOT FF4 | Complement of flip-flop 4. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 4

Changes on: rising edge of CLOCK

- CLEAR low: Q = 0 (Q' = 1) at once
- CLEAR high, rising CLOCK edge: Q = D
- CLEAR high, CLOCK high or low (no edge): hold

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CLEAR | any Q' | PLH | 16 | 25 |
| CLEAR | any Q | PHL | 23 | 35 |
| CLOCK | any output | PLH | 20 | 30 |
| CLOCK | any output | PHL | 24 | 35 |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin | Against | Min ns | Min MHz | Typ MHz |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| max clock frequency | CLOCK |  |  | 25 | 35 |
| pulse width | CLOCK or CLEAR |  | 20 |  |  |
| setup | D | CLOCK | 20 |  |  |
| setup | CLEAR inactive state | CLOCK | 25 |  |  |
| hold | D | CLOCK | 5 |  |  |
